items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 103:1
items.html: By force of the first restriction made upon the Malchut, she concludes upon the upper light, because she cannot receive it, and the light is found interrupted because of her. And this is the secret of the point of this world, which is empty void and hollow of all light, since it stands beneath the concluding Malchut. And by the second restriction, the Malchut ascended to the place of Bina and concluded the light at the Bina of the body, at the place of the Chazeh [chest], that is, the Chazeh of the Partzuf TNHY of AK, and the Partzuf Nekudot of SAG of AK; and there a Parsa was spread, and from the Parsa downward became empty and hollow void. And afterward, because of the breaking of the vessels of the seven lower Sefirot of Nekudim, front and back, which fell into the empty void beneath the Parsa, the place of the void from the Parsa downward also expanded with the discernment of vessels of the interior and vessels of the back, which are: HBD HGT up to the Chazeh [chest], called vessels of the interior; and TNHYM from the Chazeh downward, called vessels of the back. And the place of the vessels of the interior became the discernment of holiness, and there the Partzufim of BYA were sorted; and from the Chazeh downward remained entirely empty and hollow void, which are the fourteen Sefirot up to this world, that is, the place of the vessels of the TNHY that were broken, standing there. And after the sin of the First Man, the worlds were corrupted greatly, until the four lower [Sefirot] of the holy Yetzirah and all the ten Sefirot of the holy Assiyah descended and clothed themselves in the place of the fourteen Sefirot of the Klipot.
